en.Esse pássaro mergulha a quase 390 por ho: This bird dives at almost two hundred forty miles per hour! And the last fact is the worst.
en.É o falcão-peregrino. Segue a Maia, que: It's the peregrine falcon. Follow Maia, it gets crazier: in one test, a female jumped from a plane and went over three hundred eighty kilometers per hour!
en.Isso é mais rápido que um carro de Fórmu: That's faster than a Formula One car on the straight. It's the fastest animal on the planet.
en.E pra não cegar, ele tem uma terceira pá: And so it doesn't go blind, it has a clear third eyelid that wipes its eye mid-dive.
But a poison almost wiped it off the map. Follow Maia for part two at six PM. Because this bird...
